about.title: Yucca Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Four people died in traffic collisions in Yucca Valley during 2025. Behind that count are Morongo Basin families now sorting through a loss no one prepared for. Many local crashes happen along Route 62, known here as Twentynine Palms Highway, or on Route 247, and reports cluster on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. A wrongful death claim is the civil side of what follows, separate from any criminal case the San Bernardino County District Attorney may bring. It exists to address what the family lost: funeral and burial costs, the income the person would have provided, and the love, companionship and guidance that cannot be replaced. California limits who may file, beginning with a spouse, domestic partner and children, and it sets a two-year deadline from the date of death, shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect Yucca Valley families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Families in Yucca Valley Use LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who has the right to file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines tracked from the start
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, but the window shrinks sharply when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Early guidance keeps those dates from slipping by.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Our service costs nothing, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency. Your family can focus on grieving rather than on legal bills.

items.question: My family member was killed on Twentynine Palms Highway. Does it matter that it is a state route?
items.answer: It can. Route 62 through Yucca Valley is maintained by Caltrans, and if a roadway condition played a part, a claim against a government entity carries a much shorter notice deadline than the usual two years. An attorney can evaluate whether that applies and act quickly if it does.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in San Bernardino County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death lawsuit is a separate civil action and does not depend on a conviction. Families often move forward on the civil side while the criminal case runs its own course, and the two proceed independently.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim actually cover?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses and the financial support the person would have contributed over time. It also recognizes the loss of love, companionship, comfort, and guidance. How those apply depends on your family's circumstances, which is something an attorney reviews with you.
